Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: we heard that FinOpsCo prefers to pay via PO (net 30) for new vendors and that your vendor onboarding requires the following: W-9, signed MSA (or standard vendor agreement), vendor form, and a vendor code in your AP system.

What we can help with now:
- I attached our W-9 and a draft MSA for your legal team to review.
- We can accept PO terms (Net 30); we also support credit-card payments if you want a faster pilot path.
- If you prefer PO, we’ll need the remit address and vendor onboarding contact (and any portal URL).

Questions for you:
1) Will your procurement team complete vendor onboarding now or after the pilot?
2) Any specific invoice remit or reference fields we should include?
3) Is FinOpsCo interested in an AWS Marketplace purchase (that can simplify billing) or must we be a direct vendor?

Proposed next step: if procurement is ready, can you share the vendor form and AP contact? I’ll loop in our finance ops to expedite.

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Confirming the procurement position: we will need to onboard Redwood as a vendor before we can issue a PO. A few notes from our AP team:
- Preferred payment method: PO (Net 30). Credit card is allowed for small pilots but procurement prefers PO for any multi-seat pilots or production pilots.
- Required docs: W-9 (received), completed vendor onboarding form (I attached our PDF template), copy of signed MSA/terms, and our internal supplier questionnaire for security/soc.
- AWS Marketplace: Procurement prefers Marketplace purchases when available for SaaS, but they’ll accept direct vendors if we have a completed onboarding. Marketplace procurement would be faster for Finance.

I attached the vendor onboarding form — can you return that completed? Also looping AP (ap@finopsco.com) to start the vendor setup.

We aim to get vendors onboarded within ~10 business days once paperwork is complete.

Sofia
Sofia Ramirez
